name: Prediction Engine auto-flag list
purpose: Flag predictions and callsigns that contain slurs or antisemitic, racist or other bigoted terms. A flagged item is hidden at once and sent to the host queue, where a person can restore it. Matching errs towards flagging: a false positive costs one click, a miss puts a slur on the big screen.

normalise: map look-alike characters using leet below
collapse 3+ repeats of a letter to 2 (niiigger -> niigger), then also test with repeats collapsed to 1
matching.words: Match as whole words (word boundaries), plus simple plural/suffix forms: s, es, z, y, ie, ies, ed, ing.
matching.phrases: Match after collapsing all whitespace and punctuation between words to a single space.
matching.compact: Remove every non-letter from the normalised text, then substring match. Catches spaced-out evasion (n i g g e r, k.i.k.e). Only long, unambiguous terms belong here.
matching.symbols: Match against the raw text before normalisation.
matching.allowlist: Never flag these even if a rule matches (place names and common words that contain listed strings).

notes: Identity words (jew, muslim, black, gay, trans, aboriginal) are deliberately NOT flagged. People will write about these groups in good faith, and flagging the group name itself is a form of bias.

Some listed terms have innocent uses (coon in place names, spook as a ghost, nazi in a history reference, heil, ovens, slant). They are kept because a human reviews every flag. Remove any that produce too many false positives in testing.
Hate language changes. Review this list before each public run against the ADL Hate Symbols Database (adl.org/resources/hate-symbols/search) and add new coded terms.
Apply the same check to callsigns at join. A flagged callsign is rejected with: CALLSIGN NOT ALLOWED. TRY ANOTHER.
